# Citetome

> Citetome provides evidence-led organic growth audits and human-reviewed improvements for multilingual businesses across Google and AI search. Its current computed score measures crawl comprehension. Visibility, citation and agent action are not presented as measured scores. It does not guarantee traffic, citations or rankings.

Operated by Yossra Benzad, Copenhagen, Denmark. Live product: https://api.citetome.com (Fly.io London region).

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://citetome.com/): product overview, features, FAQ
- [Pricing](https://citetome.com/pricing/): audit and managed plan tiers in EUR
- [Audit](https://citetome.com/audit/): request an organic growth baseline with 10 prioritized opportunities
- Danish (/da/) and French (/fr/) versions of the homepage, pricing and audit pages are available at https://citetome.com/da/ and https://citetome.com/fr/
- [Legal](https://citetome.com/legal/): imprint, privacy, terms, governance pact, DPA

## Live endpoints

- [Customer dashboard](https://api.citetome.com/customer): per-tenant view
- [Governance posture](https://api.citetome.com/governance): public governance state
- [Entity record](https://api.citetome.com/kg/sitemap.xml): public identifiers and first-party facts
- [Machine-readable directory](https://api.citetome.com/llms.txt): optional documentation endpoint

## Notes

- This file is optional documentation. Crawlable pages and visible, accurate structured data remain the primary public sources.
- Citetome's evidence layer records provenance for facts. It does not create reciprocal links, fabricated sources or artificial citation authority.
